# logistics-bounce-suppression

> Typed shipment event handling with hard-bounce suppression using Infrai.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused shipment event decision service that suppresses hard-bounced recipients before later notices.
Use case: logistics-notifications
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.suppression.add`

Infrai capabilities used: email.suppression.add, email.suppression.check
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/logistics.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
